blocks.text: Credibility assess karna (yeh jaanchna ke maloomat par kitna bharosa kiya ja sakta hai) ka matlab hai yeh maloom karna ke maloomat kisi expert (mahir) se ya us topic par authority (faisla karne ka haq aur zimmedari) rakhne wale se aa rahi hai ya nahi.
Misal: Pakistan mein Eid ke chand nazar aane ki maloomat official Hilal Committee (Ruet-e-Hilal Committee) se aani chahiye, social media ke unverified (jin ki sachai check nahi hui) sources se nahi.

blocks.prompt: Sehat ke mashware ke liye reliable (bharose ke qabil) source kaun hai?
blocks.explanation: Qualified doctor ya sehat ka official idara, kyunke unhein is topic ka ilm aur authority hai; social media ki be-naam (anonymous) post nahi.

items: Credibility: kya source expert ya authority wala hai? Eid ka chand: official Hilal Committee, social media nahi.
